notes.title: Cupid's Chatroom Kickstarter Live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! If you didn't know, the Kickstarter for Cupid's Chatroom is live and ongoing still. We're currently past 50% funding, halfway to our goal! 

The campaign will end on [u][b]June 5 at 11 am CST / 9 am PST[/b][/u], so there's enough time to back us if you'd like and grab a full game key and other rewards. We have a lot of cute rewards for our backers ❤️

Let's bring the full game to life by helping us reach our funding goal! 🎉

🔗 [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/atelieronmoon/cupids-chatroom-an-18-dating-chatsim]Cupid's Chatroom Kickstarter page[/url]
